data.action: 双手背撑床沿微仰注视
data.description: 【圣园未花 · 晨曦私语白蔷薇寝所】圣三一茶会顶层的私密贵宾卧房，清晨第一缕阳光穿透拱形落地窗与轻盈飘拂的蕾丝白纱，未花双手背撑在床沿微微后仰，浅粉长发与纯白羽翼如晨曦般展开，琥珀金眸带着温柔依恋的笑意凝视着你。
data.lighting: 清晨阳光与丁达尔丁达尔圣光
data.promptProse: Mika sits at the guest-bedroom bed edge with both hands braced behind her, leaning back slightly in her pastel-pink sundress and ivory cardigan. Her pink hair and white wings spread around a gentle smile. The three-quarter medium view includes the bedspread beneath her and arched floor windows beyond lace curtains. Early sunlight through the gauze lights her hair and dress trim, leaving soft folded shadows on the bedding.
